note: Empty by design. The direction is unsigned, so no fit on a real outcome has been run and no number from one exists. The entries below are placeholders written in the registrar's entry() shape so that the eventual patch is mechanical rather than a re-derivation, per NUMBERS_PROTOCOL.md section 5. Every value is null and every entry is state 'not_produced'. A number is moved to state 'staged' only after A6 signs the pre-registration and the pre-registered fit has been run once. git_commit is left empty for the orchestrator, because agents in this program never run git.

design_side_artifact.note: Committed and re-runnable today. It carries the aliasing geometry, the address precision ceiling and the split demonstration. None of it is a result of the hypothesis and none of it is staged as one. It exists so that A6 can re-run the design-side claims of the pre-registration rather than read them.

entries.label: fitted fire term at zero years since fire

registrar_entry.derivation: posterior median of the burned indicator times the root-strength term evaluated at years since fire of zero, under calendar specification M-B

entries.evaluation_frame: as RES-SLIDE-0001, plus the calendar specification, which must be quoted because the term is not stable across specifications by construction
entries.notes: Failing condition F1 reads this entry's interval. It is the one quantity the design has the most support for, because it is a burned against unburned contrast at years since fire of zero.

entries.label: identified curvature of the fire term over years since fire

entries.notes: The linear component of the same term is NOT identified and has no entry here, deliberately. Giving it a key path would invite it to be quoted.
